title: Configurational Temperature in Matrix Models and Random Matrix Ensembles
summary: We investigate the configurational temperature estimator in interacting matrix models and Gaussian random-matrix ensembles. The estimator follows from an exact Schwinger--Dyson identity and may be expressed in terms of the gradient and Hessian of the action. We study the Gross--Witten--Wadia model, a quartic double-well matrix model, and the Gaussian Orthogonal, Unitary, and Symplectic Ensembles.
